name: Saturday Night Drop Zone (12 October 1997)

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline, both served parts.

notes: Two-part broadcast (both served). Closes on a three-way tag title match crowning Blackblood and Archangel (as Satan's Minions) the new Virginia Tag Team Champions over the Turbanators and the Activists From Hell. The card's other matches (Robert DiArgo vs. "Living Legend" Eric Cooper; Xavier Othello vs. Polo Stetson) are served in full but not separately structured.
